pipeline.title: Endeavor’s threat to IPF incumbents increases after phase 2 win for Hedgehog inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Endeavor BioMedicines solidified its potential threat to Big Pharma with a phase 2b readout suggesting its Hedgehog inhibitor could become the first drug to reduce lung fibrosis while increasing total lung capacity.

pipeline.title: Ono pays $80M for regional rights to trio of Biohaven IgG degraders, including phase 3 Grave’s asset
pipeline.summary: Japan’s Ono Pharmaceutical is paying $80 million upfront for the regional rights to a trio of Biohaven’s IgG degraders, led by a phase 3-stage Grave’s disease prospect.

pipeline.title: Zealand, Roche’s ‘intriguing’ weight loss for amylin drug soured by blood sugar data
pipeline.summary: Zealand Pharma has reported more phase 2 data on its Roche-partnered amylin analog, linking the drug candidate to competitive weight loss but a lackluster effect on blood sugar.

pipeline.title: Argenx digests phase 2 celiac win for $2.2B drug, preps pivotal run
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 celiac disease trial of argenx’s FB102 has hit its primary endpoint, delivering a boost to a drug candidate that the biotech acquired in its $2.2 billion takeover of Forte Biosciences.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H unveils Surpass program to accelerate and expand clinical trials
pipeline.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced the launch of a new program aimed at removing barriers that slow clinical development and transforming how clinical trials are designed and conducted.

pipeline.title: Cerevance rescues its Parkinson's drug with phase 3 win
pipeline.summary: Cerevance's oral non-dopaminergic therapy has redeemed itself by improving both motor and non-motor symptoms in a phase 3 Parkinson's disease study.

pipeline.title: Atsena’s Lighthouse gene therapy readout illuminates eye disease efficacy
pipeline.summary: Atsena Therapeutics has reported evidence of efficacy in a clinical trial of an eye disease gene therapy, encouraging the biotech to forge ahead with a study that could support a filing for approval in 2028.

pipeline.title: A Takeda spinout builds case for its Parkinson’s drug
pipeline.summary: Cerevance plans to meet with the FDA to determine next steps for a new kind of medicine known as solengepras, now that it has Phase 3 data in hand.

pipeline.title: MimiVax’s cancer vaccine fails phase 2 glioblastoma study, but CEO still sees data as ‘inspiring’
pipeline.summary: MimiVax has reports a phase 2b miss in newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients, but remains positive about a significant survival benefit in a subset of patients 65 years and under.

pipeline.title: ArriVent’s phase 3 lung cancer trial flops, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 lung cancer study of ArriVent BioPharma’s EGFR inhibitor has missed its primary endpoint, sending the biotech’s stock down 57% in early trading on the Nasdaq.

pipeline.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval for new CardioMEMS HF System that allows heart readings to be seen at home
pipeline.summary: Abbott has been given U.S. clearance for new updates to its CardioMEMS HF System that allow for patient-facing capabilities through its CardioGuide HF App.

pipeline.title: [Podcast] (Season 2) The Progress Profile: Alzheimer’s Research in Focus
pipeline.summary: This podcast explores how leading Alzheimer’s experts are working to bridge the gap between clinical trial design and frontline care.

pipeline.title: Proposed nuclear safety rules threaten to stall Novartis’ Pluvicto expansion
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ flagship radioligand therapy Pluvicto entered a rapid growth phase recently, driven by FDA approvals in earlier-stage prostate cancer and broader uptake in community settings. But a regulatory overhaul proposed by federal nuclear authorities now threatens to derail that

pipeline.title: BMS fills out Zenbexus picture with post-approval PFS victory in multiple myeloma
pipeline.summary: BMS has put up the progression-free survival numbers on its recently approved Zenbexus regimen, more than doubling the score over a control cocktail of daratumumab, bortezomib and dexamethasone.

pipeline.title: Viatris boosts pain drug portfolio with $1.7B buyout of Pacira
pipeline.summary: The deal hands Viatris two non-opioid pain treatments that booked nearly $700 million in 2025 but could soon lose patent protection. Viatris vowed to use its “intellectual property expertise” to sustain sales.

pipeline.title: Argenx falls as Sjögren’s setback offsets celiac drug progress
pipeline.summary: A monitoring board’s recommendation to stop the study for futility took Wall Street by surprise, removing one more ‘blockbuster expansion opportunity’ for Vyvgart.

pipeline.title: In the hunt for reverse merger targets, Caribou could be prized game
pipeline.summary: The struggling cell therapy developer is exploring strategic alternatives, which, among other characteristics, make it a likely candidate to receive reverse merger interest.

pipeline.title: Viatris to snap up Pacira's non-opioid pain pipeline for $1.65B
pipeline.summary: In a push to up its investments in patent-protected medicines, Viatris is set to acquire Pacira BioSciences, including two high-margin non-opioid pain therapies.

pipeline.title: Argenx walks away from Vyvgart Sjögren's disease trial after futility flag
pipeline.summary: Just shy of two months after teeing up its FcRn blocker Vyvgart Hytrulo for entry into another potential immunology niche, argenx has stumbled in a late-stage trial testing the drug against a separate target.

pipeline.title: CSL Seqirus blasted for ‘multiple and prolonged deficiencies’
pipeline.summary: A U.K. drug marketing watchdog has slammed CSL Seqirus for “multiple and prolonged deficiencies” in its systems, governance and oversight.

pipeline.title: Pfizer's Tukysa snags first-line approval in HER2+ breast cancer maintenance
pipeline.summary: Pfizer bagged a coveted first-line maintenance approval for Tukysa. In combination with HER2 antibody drugs, the treatment can significantly delay disease progression for patients with advanced breast cancer.

pipeline.title: Melissa explains it all in menopause team up with Bayer
pipeline.summary: Bayer is teaming up with American actress and director Melissa Joan Hart to boost awareness about hot flashes treatment Lynkuet by tapping her personal experiences.

pipeline.title: AI biotech Iambic aims for $135M IPO to push cancer drugs through clinic
pipeline.summary: Iambic Therapeutics is aiming to raise $135 million in net proceeds from an IPO as the AI biotech looks to fund the clinical development of its lead cancer drug.

pipeline.title: PhRMA launches new legal challenge as CMS brings 'most favored nation' pricing to Medicare Part B
pipeline.summary: As the Trump administration advances plans to bring its “most favored nation” drug pricing model to Medicare Part B, the pharmaceutical industry’s top lobbying group is pushing back in court.

pipeline.title: Novartis' Rhapsido tackles 2 most common forms of chronic hives with swift FDA expansion
pipeline.summary: A little over a year after landing its flagship approval in chronic hives, Novartis’ oral BTK inhibitor Rhapsido is expanding its reach with a new FDA nod that comes with a notable ‘first’ for the field.

pipeline.title: Theramex pays up to $250M for Asieris' novel cervical lesion treatment
pipeline.summary: Should an EU approval go through, the deal allows Asieris to piggyback its global expansion on Theramex’s established women’s health infrastructure across Europe.

pipeline.title: Cadrenal launches strategic review for late-stage cardiology pipeline
pipeline.summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics, a heart-focused biotech that recently reached an agreement with the FDA on the design of a pivotal trial for its lead candidate, is now instead looking to offload its pipeline or potentially the entire company.

pipeline.title: Sanofi drafts NY Knicks star Karl-Anthony Towns for COVID, Nuvaxovid awareness push
pipeline.summary: New York Knicks champ Karl-Anthony Towns is sharing his personal experience with COVID to encourage others to talk with their doctors about vaccination options.

pipeline.title: Caribou to halt CAR-T work, lay off staff amid ‘challenging’ funding climate
pipeline.summary: Despite having an allogeneic cell therapy prospect that’s ready for late-stage testing in lymphoma, Caribou couldn’t secure funding to support the effort and will now pursue “strategic alternatives” instead.

pipeline.title: Halozyme prevails in patent fight with Merck; Enliven readies anticipated leukemia trial
pipeline.summary: A Dutch court barred Merck from selling subcutaneous Keytruda in several European countries. Elsewhere, an Insmed executive ended a seven-year run and two startups secured venture cash.

pipeline.title: Halozyme stymies subcutaneous Keytruda launch in select European countries as Merck vows to fight patent claims
pipeline.summary: After facing a setback in Germany late last year, Merck & Co.’s European marketing plans for its below-the-skin Keytruda SC are growing more complicated.

pipeline.title: TCGX launches $600M fund to bankroll Asian biotechs
pipeline.summary: Investment firm TCGX is expanding in Asia, raising $600 million to funnel into biotechs emerging from a burgeoning drug discovery hotspot.

pipeline.title: New API Innovation Center index spotlights supply chain stress points
pipeline.summary: The National Fragility Index, launched by the API Innovation Center, warned that more than 550 million prescriptions filled in the U.S. in 2023 were categorized as being highly or severely vulnerable to supply chain interruptions.

pipeline.title: Catalent wins access to Iro and launches next-gen development platform
pipeline.summary: Catalent will gain access to Ori's Iro platform, a proprietary automated cell and gene therapy manufacturing system that speeds up development and reduces costs.

pipeline.title: Matchpoint nets $150M series B to take covalent med into clinic
pipeline.summary: Matchpoint Therapeutics has aced its series B round, serving up $150 million to advance the Sanofi-backed biotech’s pipeline of precision covalent medicines.

pipeline.title: Stryker strikes up a new CEO in Spencer Stiles as Kevin Lobo moves upstairs
pipeline.summary: Stryker veteran Spencer Stiles will take up the chief executive role as its former CEO Kevin Lobo will move into the boardroom.

pipeline.title: CAR-T biotech Caribou makes ‘heartbreaking’ call to shrink headcount, halt pipeline
pipeline.summary: The Bay Area biotech is discontinuing all clinical development activities and implementing a "substantial reduction in workforce."

pipeline.title: Noom puts a spooky voice to the haunting threat of weight regain for GLP-1 users in new spot
pipeline.summary: Noom's horror movie-esque new ad showcases the haunting threat of weight regain on GLP-1s, which the Noom app can help fend off.

pipeline.title: How drugmakers are tapping into the GLP-1 frenzy's unprecedented 'consumer overlay'
pipeline.summary: With the advent of powerful GLP-1 medications from Novo and Eli Lilly, the conversation about obesity as a chronic disease has begun to shift, along with the understanding of how tackling weight can trigger a multitude of downstream health benefits.

pipeline.title: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig halts development of lead fusion protein in rare autoimmune disease
pipeline.summary: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig Therapeutics has halted one of the two trials for its sole clinical asset after determining the program wouldn’t be able to advance quickly enough.

pipeline.title: Forbion, a prominent biotech investor, raises $2.6B for a pair of venture funds
pipeline.summary: The fundraise is the firm’s largest to date, providing a lift for a European biotech industry that’s fallen further behind its counterparts in the U.S. and China.

pipeline.title: ArriVent collapses on disappointing lung cancer data
pipeline.summary: More than half of the company’s value was wiped out by findings that appear to erase a chance to battle Johnson & Johnson and others for market share.

pipeline.title: Dual-acting drug from AbbVie, Genmab scores in frontline lymphoma trial
pipeline.summary: The better-than-expected results could make Epkinly the new “undisputed” treatment standard in newly diagnosed DLBCL, according to one analyst.

pipeline.title: ViiV girds data package for Cabenuva in competitive HIV treatment market
pipeline.summary: As competition in both the HIV treatment and prevention fields continues to mount, GSK’s ViiV Healthcare is looking to expand the reach of its long-acting Cabenuva, homing in on the combination treatment’s potential to help people whose infection isn’t adequately kept in check by

pipeline.title: Rising Stars: How VML Health’s Molly Kanofsky turns ‘an idea on a page’ into real-world impact
pipeline.summary: VML Health's Molly Kanofsky ended up in the pharma marketing world after an unexpected career detour, where she's now able to merge her passion for healthcare with her creative side.

pipeline.title: AbbVie, Genmab score first-line DLBCL win for Epkinly, teeing up challenge to Roche's Polivy
pipeline.summary: Epkinly plus R-CHOP cut the risk of progression or death by 51% compared with R-CHOP alone in newly diagnosed DLBCL, setting up a potential first-line challenge to Roche’s Polivy.

pipeline.title: Kairos seizes moment to push prostate cancer prospect into earlier setting
pipeline.summary: Kairos Pharma is moving prostate cancer prospect ENV-105 into an earlier line of treatment in response to midphase survival data.

pipeline.title: BD commits $19B amid US onshoring push, with $3B earmarked for manufacturing growth
pipeline.summary: With a substantial multi-year investment in the offing, BD has joined a wave of healthcare companies upping their commitments to the U.S., this time focusing squarely on medical technology and the essential consumables used daily by doctors and patients.

pipeline.title: Forbion’s ‘landmark’ €2.3B fundraise to benefit 30 ‘high potential’ biotechs
pipeline.summary: Forbion has touted its “landmark” 2.3 billion euro ($2.6 billion) fundraise across two funds as a new record for the European life sciences-focused VC firm.

pipeline.title: UK unveils new policy to constantly monitor AI-based medical devices
pipeline.summary: The U.K.’s drug and medical technology regulatory body the MHRA will continually monitor all artificial intelligence-based devices.

pipeline.title: Biotech’s peptide shows promise as ‘bait molecule’ to treat neuropathic pain in mice
pipeline.summary: While psychedelic drugs may be capturing all the attention when it comes to finding fresh ways to treat neuropathic pain, research with mice has suggested a peptide approach may also be effective.

pipeline.title: Genentech celebrates 50 years of 'The Impossible Bet' in anniversary documentary
pipeline.summary: Known as the "original biotech," Genentech is unlocking its archives to shine light on its past, present and future in a new documentary celebrating its 50-year anniversary.

pipeline.title: Scaling psychedelics comes with uncertainty ‘baked into the sauce’
pipeline.summary: The possibility of psychedelic therapies for PTSD or treatment-resistant depression in the U.S. has never been greater. But even as the industry inches closer to an FDA go-ahead, the realities of approved psychedelic medicine are far from decided.

pipeline.title: Shionogi strikes $2B deal for IntraBio hot off FDA label expansion
pipeline.summary: The acquisition builds on Shionogi’s plans to diversify beyond its anti-infectious disease drug base and to beef up its budding rare disease unit.

pipeline.title: Gilead partners with Calm to roll out disease-specific emotional wellness support
pipeline.summary: Sleep app Calm is helping Gilead achieve its dream of helping its patients through a journey of whole-person health.

pipeline.title: For biopharma manufacturing at speed and scale, the future is flexible
pipeline.summary: Biopharma development has long trended toward specialized and personalized therapies such as cell and gene therapies, antibody-drug conjugates, and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), among others.

pipeline.title: How NIH’s Nicole Kleinstreuer is working to reduce animal testing while avoiding a ‘backlash’
pipeline.summary: In the past 18 months, the National Institutes of Health has been working overtime to push new policies to reduce animal testing with the help of one woman at the helm: Nicole Kleinstreuer, Ph.D.

pipeline.title: ‘It’s just survival now’: Why is almost a third of Boston’s life sciences lab space sitting vacant?
pipeline.summary: Vacancy rates for lab and manufacturing spaces in Massachusetts increased 11-fold to 31% between 2021 and 2026. So what's gone wrong?

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Caribou cuts staff, halts pipeline; Foghorn reduces workforce by 40%
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Matchpoint makes $150M; KymaThera corrals $80M
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
